note: Japanese lists are sorted in kana order, which begins a, i, u, e, o, the way English lists are sorted A to Z. The English game put "A to Z" here.
claim: Japanese words are conventionally sorted in gojūon kana order, which begins a, i, u, e, o.

check.quote: The gojūon order is the prevalent system for collating Japanese in Japan. For example, dictionaries are ordered using this method.
